tagline: You can now manage Lakebase backup schedules programmatically.
what_it_does: You can now manage Lakebase backup schedules programmatically. The snapshot schedule API lets you read and set a root branch's automated snapshot cadences (daily, weekly, or monthly) and how long each cadence's snapshots are retained. This API is in Beta and available to all Lakebase workspaces.
why_it_matters: Lakebase creates snapshots instantly with minimal performance impact.
